verdict.rationale: The firm's executive compensation page says it designs equity instruments (restricted stock, ISOs/NSOs, RSUs, SARs, phantom stock) with vesting and acceleration features, which covers the core US option-plan part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows non-US schemes, and the listed offices include no UK, German or Indian locations. Missing for 10: any evidence of UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOP design; any international equity-plan coverage; independent corroboration.
